landing.title: Sadhana Pro
landing.subtitle: Sadhana tracker and chart — a tracker for spiritual practice, meditation, and habits
landing.description: Sadhana Pro is a powerful and flexible sadhana (daily spiritual practice) diary that helps you track your daily practices, habits, and meditation. You can track your activities in convenient tables or monitor your progress on visual graphs. The app is ideal for both regular spiritual practice and systematically tracking your daily tasks and habits. With Sadhana Pro, you can consciously develop your spiritual discipline.
landing.freeForever: Free forever · No credit card required

keyFeatures.title: Key Features
keyFeatures.customisableDescription: Add your own fields with types like numbers, text, boolean, time of day, and duration.
keyFeatures.offlineDescription: Enter your data even without an internet connection.
keyFeatures.installDescription: Add it to your phone's home screen for a native app-like experience.
keyFeatures.shareDescription: A private link for each mentor or friend: you choose which charts they see and from which date, and can switch it off at any time.
keyFeatures.groupDescription: Join a group, track the same practices and see everyone's day at a glance.
keyFeatures.dataDescription: Import and export your data as CSV files for backup and analysis.
keyFeatures.insightsDescription: An overview of this week against your usual, ready-made charts for sleep, japa and study, a year map and your weekly rhythm.
keyFeatures.growthDescription: Insights compares each period with your own usual pattern. You can see where you've stepped up, where you've gone quieter, and what's slipped, all without streaks or scores.

devices.title: Phone, tablet, desktop

help.title: Guides
help.intro: Short how-tos for Sadhana Pro: installing it on your phone, setting up practices, reading your reports, practising with a group and sharing your progress.
help.question: Still have a question?
help.questionText: Ask in our Telegram channel, or write to us from the app: Settings › Help and support.

install.title: Install Sadhana Pro on your phone
install.summary: Add Sadhana Pro to your Home Screen so it opens like an app, full screen, and keeps working offline. No app store needed.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad
ios.text:
Open Sadhana Pro in Safari and sign in.
Tap Share. If you don't see it, look in the ⋯ menu.
Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then Add. Sadhana Pro now opens from its icon, without the browser bars.

android.title: Android
android.text:
Open Sadhana Pro in Chrome and sign in.
Tap the ⋮ menu, then “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”, and confirm. The icon appears with your other apps.

computer.title: Computer
computer.text:
In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or find Install in the browser menu. Sadhana Pro then opens in its own window.
A bookmark works too: everything works in an ordinary tab.

offline.title: Working offline
offline.text: Once you've opened Sadhana Pro on a device, it keeps working without a connection. What you log offline is kept on the device and sent as soon as you're back online. Until then, Today shows how many changes are waiting.

practices.title: Set up your practices
practices.summary: A practice is one row you fill in each day on Today, like japa rounds, wake-up time or reading. How to add them and choose the right type.

add.title: Add a practice
add.text:
Go to Settings › Practices and tap Add. Give the practice a name and choose its type.
Choose the type carefully: it can't be changed later.

types.title: Which type to choose
types.text:
Number: a count, like rounds or pages.
Time of day: a clock time, like when you woke up or went to bed.
Duration: time spent, like minutes of reading or meditation.
Tick: done or not.
Text: a word or a short note.
Number and Text practices can also use “Pick from a list”: on Today you choose one of your own values instead of typing it.

today.title: Arrange Today
today.text:
Practices appear on Today in the order of the list. Drag them by the dots to reorder. Groups split Today into sections, such as Morning and Evening.
Mark a practice Required and any past day where it's missing gets a red dot in the calendar.
If you stop doing a practice, hide it from Today rather than deleting it. Hiding keeps all its data; deleting removes it for good.

helpChoose.title: Not sure where to start?
helpChoose.text: When you add a practice, choose “Help me choose”. You'll see what each report looks like after a few weeks of logging, pick the ones you'd like, and Sadhana Pro sets up their practices for you.

reports.title: See your progress in Insights
reports.summary: Insights turns what you log into charts and tables. Use a ready-made report, or build your own graph or table.

find.title: Overview and your reports
find.text:
Open the Insights tab. Overview compares your recent days with your usual range and counts the days you practised. Choose 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or a year.
Your own reports sit next to Overview: pick one to open it.

readyMade.title: Ready-made reports
readyMade.text:
Tap New chart in Insights (in the ⋯ menu on a phone) or in Settings › Insights. A ready-made report needs only a short form: pick your practices and targets, and the report is built for you.
Sleep: bedtime, wake-up and hours slept. Daily count: a number each day against a target, such as rounds. Time spent: time across practices, with a goal. Days I did it: done days month by month. Days between events: how long between one event and the next. Goals: how much a day, week or month.

graph.title: Build a graph
graph.text:
Choose Build your own › Graph. Each series plots one practice as bars, a line or dots. Series of the same kind share an axis; a different kind gets its own axis on the other side.
Turn on Show average for a dashed line at your average. With two or more bar series, choose whether the bars sit grouped, stacked or overlaid.

table.title: Build a table
table.text:
Choose Build your own › Table and tick the practices to show. Days are rows and practices are columns; turn on Group columns to follow your practice groups.
You can also download a report's data as a CSV file.

yatras.title: Practise together in a yatra
yatras.summary: A yatra is a group that practises together. Everyone sees one table with each member's day, so you can keep each other going.

what.title: What a yatra is
what.text:
A yatra has its own list of practices, set by its admins. The Yatra tab shows a table with a row for each member and a column for each practice, coloured by how the day went.
Only the practices you link to the yatra show up there. The rest of your diary stays private.

join.title: Join a yatra
join.text: Ask the yatra's admin for an invite link and open it while signed in. You'll see the yatra and its members; tap Join Yatra.

link.title: Link your practices
link.text:
After joining, link your practices to the yatra's. Each yatra practice is filled from one practice of yours of the same type, and suggested matches are offered first.
No practices yet? Create all and link adds them to Today under the yatra's names and links them in one go.
Until a practice is linked, your cell in its column stays empty, even if you log it on Today. You can change links any time in Settings › Yatras.

create.title: Create your own
create.text:
In Settings › Yatras, create a new yatra. You become its admin: add practices, then send the invite link to those who will practise with you.
Admins can colour cells by value, add a daily score with done and bonus thresholds, add statistics above the table, and make other members admins.

sharing.title: Share your progress
sharing.summary: Send a mentor or friend a link to just the charts you choose. You can withdraw any link at any time.

link.title: Make a link
link.text:
Go to Settings › Sharing and tap New link. Write who it's for (only you see this name), tick the charts to include, and choose the day it opens on: today, or a set date.
Save, then copy the link or share it straight from your phone.

open.title: What they see
open.text: The link opens in any browser, no account needed. It shows only the charts you picked, and can be moved to other dates. Your list of links shows when each was last opened.

withdraw.title: Withdraw access
withdraw.text:
Open the link in Settings › Sharing and tap Withdraw. It stops working for good; to share again, make a new link.
The old public link, which shows all your charts, can be turned off on the same screen.
